objective: Implement a self-contained Triton vector addition kernel for two CUDA float32 tensors.

operator_contract.inputs: Two contiguous one-dimensional float32 tensors x and y of equal length n
operator_contract.output: A new float32 tensor with elementwise x + y

shape_domain.n: Positive lengths including non-power-of-two lengths and tails smaller than a block

invariants: Mask all out-of-bounds loads and stores
